newsitem.title: INDIA: India ICICI, SCICI merger soon.
newsitem.headline: India ICICI, SCICI merger soon.

text.p: The proposed merger of term lending bank SCICI Ltd with the Industrial Credit and Investment Corp of India Ltd (ICICI) will be effected soon, the ICICI managing director told a news conference on Monday.
"The merger would be through in the next few weeks or so," ICICI managing director Kundapur V. Kamath said.
At separate board meetings held on December 31, 1996, ICICI and SCICI had approved a proposal for merger of SCICI with ICICI effective April 1, 1997.
Kamath said ICICI was pursuing its goal of becoming a universal bank in due course.
"I hope the regulatory changes will allow us to become a true universal bank in two to three years," he said.
